'''Urien''' is an Aielman of the [[Two Spires]] sept of the [[Reyn]] [[Aiel]]. He is an ''[[Aethan Dor]]''. He is, interestingly, the first Aielman encountered in the entire series.

== Appearance ==
He is tall with short red hair that has a tail down to the back of his neck.

== Activities ==
He is met by [[Mat Cauthon]], [[Perrin Aybara]], [[Ingtar Shinowa]] and the rest of the [[Shienaran]]s on the hunt for the [[Horn of Valere]]. He is not afraid that he is outnumbered and is looking for "[[Car'a'carn|He who comes with the Dawn]]".{{ref/book|2|28}}

He is in charge of the [[Red Shields]] in [[Cairhien]]. When [[Rand al'Thor]] goes to [[Shadar Logoth]] to find the [[Waygate]], Urien is one of the Aiel that escort him there and participates in the search for [[Liah]]. He leads a large contingent of ''[[siswai'aman]]'' to help rescue Rand from the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]] and participates in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].

==Parallels==
Urien shares the name of a [[wikipedia:Urien|Welsh king]] who by the time of Malory had been made the unhappy husband of Morgan le Fay and father to their child, Ywain, in Arthurian legends.{{ref/book|origins|Urien}}
